description: The Board of Directors of Rotary Club of Deonar met on 18 October 2026 to review the progress of ongoing community service initiatives and discuss upcoming projects. Key discussions included classroom digitalisation at Nutan Vidhya Mandir, the Happitude mental health programme, Touching Little Hearts, the musculoskeletal corrective surgery project, educational support for Subhash Chandra Bose School, blood donation and eye and dental screening camps, and the autism-focused Global Grant project. The Board also reviewed project allocations and approved funding for various community service initiatives.
